purpose: Adds bounded retries to the upload path so transient S3 failures stop surfacing to end users as hard errors.
changes: Wraps the S3 put call in a bounded retry with jittered backoff
Threads a per-request deadline through the storage client
Adds a metrics counter for exhausted retry budgets

subsystems.name: storage-client
subsystems.role: wraps the S3 SDK and owns timeouts

watchItems: The PR body claims the retry is idempotent, but no idempotency key is sent with the put
unclear: Whether the new per-request deadline interacts correctly with the outer HTTP timeout
